group.passage: Air pollution is not always easy to see, but it can still harm our health. One common way to measure it is PM2.5, which means tiny bits in the air that are 2.5 micrometers across or smaller. Breathing in fine particles like these is linked to heart and lung diseases. The chart below shows the yearly average amount of PM2.5 at one air-quality station in each of three cities, Taipei, Taichung, and Kaohsiung, for every year from 2015 to 2025. At all three stations, the average in 2025 was lower than in 2015. In 2015, the station in Kaohsiung recorded 25.8 micrograms per cubic meter, the highest of the three, and by 2025 the number had fallen to 16.1. Taichung's average dropped even more, from 24.9 to 13.6. Taipei had the cleanest air from the start, and its average went from 19.0 down to 12.5. However, the numbers did not go down every single year; in some years they rose before falling again. What made the air cleaner? The government worked on several sources of pollution at the same time. At the coal-fired Taichung Power Plant, four large boilers were upgraded by 2020, a change that was expected to cut the plant's air pollution by 80 percent within five years. Some state-run companies replaced their coal-burning boilers with gas-burning ones. On the roads, owners of old, high-polluting motorcycles were offered rewards for giving them up. In the first eleven months of 2022 alone, 1.68 million of these motorcycles were taken off the roads. Not all of the change came from the government's work, however. The weather also lent a hand. In 2022, for example, more rain fell in parts of Taiwan, and this helped make the air cleaner. That year, pollution blown over from China also dropped by 20 to 30 percent. Even so, the environmental agency said that steps taken inside Taiwan had cut local pollution by 82 percent, far more than the 60 percent it had planned.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: How one coal-fired power plant in Taichung cut its air pollution.
options.B: Why more rain fell in parts of Taiwan in 2022.
options.C: How breathing PM2.5 causes heart and lung diseases.
options.D: How the air in three Taiwanese cities got cleaner, and why.

questions.stem: According to the passage, what was done about old, high-polluting motorcycles?

options.A: They were changed so that they could burn gas.
options.B: They were no longer allowed on any roads in Taiwan.
options.C: Their owners were offered something for getting rid of them.
options.D: They were shipped to other countries where people still use them.

1.explanation_zh: 第一段介紹 PM2.5，並說圖表顯示三個城市測站 2015 到 2025 年每年的年平均值；第二段說三個測站 2025 年都比 2015 年低；第三段回答「是什麼讓空氣變乾淨」（政府的措施）；第四段說天氣和境外污染也有影響。全文講的是三個城市的空氣怎麼變乾淨、為什麼。
evidence: At all three stations, the average in 2025 was lower than in 2015.

option_notes_zh.A: 台中火力發電廠改善鍋爐是第三段列舉的其中一項措施（文中確實有寫），只是局部細節，不是全文主旨。

A: What made the air cleaner? The government worked on several sources of pollution at the same time.

1.strategy_zh: 主旨題找各段共同的主題：第二段說三個測站的數值都下降，第三段的 What made the air cleaner? 和第四段都在說原因；選能同時涵蓋「變乾淨」和「原因」的選項。

第三、四段在回答什麼問題？

option_notes_zh.D: 文中只說這些機車退出道路（taken off the roads），沒有說被運到其他國家。

4.strategy_zh: 讀圖題先找對線（Kaohsiung），再沿著這條線逐年比較找最高點；不要把文中「三個城市比較」的最高，和同一條線歷年的最高混在一起。

translation_zh.text:
空氣污染並不總是容易看見，但它仍然可能傷害我們的健康。一種常見的測量方式是 PM2.5，指的是空氣中直徑 2.5 微米以下的微小顆粒。吸入這類細懸浮微粒和心臟病、肺病有關。下面的圖表顯示台北、台中和高雄三個城市各一個空氣品質測站，從 2015 到 2025 年每一年的 PM2.5 年平均值。
三個測站 2025 年的平均值都比 2015 年低。2015 年，高雄的測站測得每立方公尺 25.8 微克，是三個城市中最高的；到了 2025 年，這個數字已降到 16.1。台中的平均值下降得更多，從 24.9 降到 13.6。台北的空氣一開始就是最乾淨的，平均值從 19.0 降到 12.5。不過，這些數字並不是每一年都下降；有些年份先上升，之後才又下降。
是什麼讓空氣變乾淨的？政府同時從好幾個污染來源下手。燃煤的台中火力發電廠到 2020 年已完成四座大型鍋爐的改善，預計五年內讓電廠的空氣污染減少八成。一些國營事業把燃煤鍋爐換成燃氣鍋爐。在道路上，老舊高污染機車的車主只要淘汰機車就能獲得獎勵。光是 2022 年的前十一個月，就有 168 萬輛這類機車退出道路。
然而，並非所有的改變都來自政府的努力。天氣也幫了忙。例如 2022 年，台灣部分地區雨量較多，這有助於空氣變乾淨。那一年，從中國飄來的污染也減少了兩到三成。即便如此，環保主管機關表示，台灣國內採取的措施讓本地污染減少了 82%，遠超過原本計畫的 60%。

checked.claim: PM2.5 means tiny bits in the air that are 2.5 micrometers across or smaller; it is one common way to measure air pollution; breathing in fine particles like these is linked to heart and lung diseases.（f1、f13、f2）

At all three stations, the average in 2025 was lower than in 2015; Kaohsiung 25.8 (highest of the three in 2015) → 16.1; Taichung dropped even more, 24.9 → 13.6; Taipei had the cleanest air from the start, 19.0 → 12.5.（f3–f6；d1：25.77→16.09〔降 9.68〕、24.87→13.57〔降 11.30〕、18.97→12.53；每一年都是台北最低。已修正 ai.rd.440e74 的 around 12）
However, the numbers did not go down every single year; in some years they rose before falling again.（d1：三站 2021 都比 2020 高；高雄 2016 比 2015 高；台中 2025 比 2024 高）

At the coal-fired Taichung Power Plant, four large boilers were upgraded by 2020, expected to cut the plant's air pollution by 80 percent within five years.（f7；Taipei Times 2020-09-12 原頁：Completion of upgrades to four boiler units at the coal-fired Taichung Power Plant earlier this year … would reduce its air pollutant emissions by 80 percent over the next five years）

Some state-run companies replaced their coal-burning boilers with gas-burning ones; owners of old, high-polluting motorcycles were offered rewards for giving them up.（f8、f9；Taipei Times 2022-12-29 原頁：replacing coal-fired boilers with gas-fired ones at some state-run companies and incentives that removed … high-emission motorcycles）

In the first eleven months of 2022 alone, 1.68 million of these motorcycles were taken off the roads.（f9 照 Taipei Times 2022-12-29 寫成 from January to last month；但同一場環保署記者會的中文報導〔工商時報 2022-12-27〈環保署公布年空氣品質監測統計 好天氣比例超過9成〉〕寫「在老舊機車部分自109年至今累計淘汰168.5萬輛」，是 2020 年起約三年的累計數；環保署 2021 年 12 月也說自 109 年起已近 122 萬輛淘汰〔ETtoday 2021-12-29〕；環境部資源回收統計 2022 年全年廢機車回收量約 55 萬輛，不可能 11 個月內淘汰 168 萬輛）

In 2022 more rain fell in parts of Taiwan, and pollution blown over from China dropped by 20 to 30 percent.（f10；Taipei Times 原頁：more rain in areas north of Miaoli County；Pollutants blown in from China have dropped 20 to 30 percent so far this year；中央社 2022-12-27：竹苗以北降雨日數較往年多、境外污染貢獻減少約 2 至 3 成）

The environmental agency said that steps taken inside Taiwan had cut local pollution by 82 percent, far more than the 60 percent it had planned.（f12；Taipei Times 原頁：The improvement in local pollution control was far better than expected, with pollutants reduced by 82 percent, surpassing the original target of 60 percent, Tsai said。中央社中文原文是「原訂減量60%空污的目標達到82%」，指標不明確；選文以 the environmental agency said 轉述，與英文來源一致，不判錯，但重寫時建議保留轉述語氣）

第 4 題與 description：高雄前金的最高點是 2016 年 28.7（d1：28.67 > 2017 的 26.67 > 2015 的 25.77 > 2018 的 24.97），也是全圖最高；台北 2022 年 9.3 是全圖最低；三條線 2021 年都比 2020 年高——都與資料一致

problems: 第三段 “In the first eleven months of 2022 alone, 1.68 million of these motorcycles were taken off the roads.” 與事實不符：1.68 百萬（168.5 萬）是 2020 年（民國 109 年）起到 2022 年底前的累計淘汰數，不是 2022 年前 11 個月就淘汰的數量。同一場環保署記者會的中文報導（工商時報 2022-12-27）寫「自109年至今累計淘汰168.5萬輛」；環保署 2021 年 12 月說自 109 年起「已近122萬輛淘汰」（ETtoday 2021-12-29；兩者相減，2022 年約 47 萬輛）；環境部資源回收統計 2022 年全年廢機車回收量約 55 萬輛。事實單 f9 照抄了 Taipei Times 英文稿 “from January to last month” 的誤譯，應改成「From 2020 to late 2022, about 1.68 million high-polluting motorcycles were taken off the roads」並附中文來源；選文的 alone 更強化了錯誤。
